beliefs.label: Keep Peace
beliefs.statement: I keep the peace so nobody has to choose sides.

receipts.quote: At dinner Tomas and Dad began arguing about the fence. I changed the subject to the tomatoes before either one raised his voice.
My aunt asked who agreed with her, and I said we could decide later. I could feel myself smoothing the room again.

beliefs.label: Love Family
beliefs.statement: I can love my family and still set a limit.

receipts.quote: Tomas wanted me to host twelve people after my long shift. I said I could come to dinner but not cook it.
Dad asked me to call the contractor again. I told him I could do it Friday, not during story hour.

beliefs.label: Making Room
beliefs.statement: Making room for a story is a form of respect.

receipts.quote: A new patron described losing her apartment in fragments. I let her finish before offering the computer sign-up sheet.
Tomas told me about his bad meeting on the porch. I put my phone away and listened until he stopped pacing.

beliefs.label: Ask For
beliefs.statement: I ask for details before I agree to family plans.

receipts.quote: Tomas suggested Thanksgiving at his place. I asked who was cooking and when we could leave before saying yes.
My cousin proposed a road trip, so I asked about rooms, costs, and return time. Then I chose one night.

beliefs.label: Trust Consistency
beliefs.statement: I trust consistency more than dramatic promises.

receipts.quote: Tomas said he would pick Dad up for his appointment, and he arrived early with water. I trusted him with the next errand.
My sister mailed the documents exactly when she said she would. That mattered more than her long apology.

beliefs.label: Become Formal
beliefs.statement: I become formal when I am hurt.

receipts.quote: When Tomas forgot my exhibit, I wrote him a very polite message. Every sentence sounded like a library notice.
Dad dismissed my plan, and I said, "Thank you for your input." He knew I was hurt immediately.

beliefs.label: Public Spaces
beliefs.statement: Public spaces should welcome people who arrive unsure.

receipts.quote: A nervous man stood by the printer holding a tax form. I walked him through the first page without rushing him.
I moved the bilingual flyers closer to the entrance. Three people picked them up before noon.

beliefs.label: Leave Room
beliefs.statement: I leave room in the schedule for my own projects.

receipts.quote: Tomas asked for help moving, but I kept Saturday morning for my pottery class. I joined him after lunch instead.
I blocked an afternoon to glaze bowls and declined a committee call. The studio was quiet and warm.

shared_items.label: How I mean things
shared_items.statement: I choose precise words when the stakes feel high.

shared_items.label: What feels like care
shared_items.statement: Remembering the context of a hard day matters to me.

shared_items.label: How to bring something up with me
shared_items.statement: Start with the event and ask what I meant before assuming.
